attributes.dkAbstract: The Department proposes to revise the existing accrediting agency recognition regulations at 34 CFR part 602 to implement the directives set forth in Executive Order 14279, Reforming Accreditation to Strengthen Higher Education, and other Administration priorities, align the regulations more closely with statute, and reduce regulatory burden.
attributes.title: Intent to Negotiate Accreditation - Accreditation, Innovation, and Modernization (AIM) Committee (Committee)
